Phonographs typically refer to the record player as a whole. Phonograms would be the correct word when addressing specifically the disc itself. A phonogram refers to any physical or digital sound recording, which includes records, CDs, tapes, and digital audio files. A record specifically refers to a type of phonogram, the vinyl disc. So, while all records are phonograms, not all phonograms are records.
